* Overview & Architecture

VS Code is maintained as a fallback graphical editor for tasks where a standard IDE is required or when collaborating with others.

**Design Philosophy**
While Doom Emacs is the primary driver for PKM and hardcore editing, VS Code is kept strictly synchronized with the Catppuccin Mocha aesthetic. Its keybindings are mapped to replicate Emacs motions where possible to reduce context-switching friction.

* Overview

VS Code is configured as a Doom Emacs complement: Vim modal editing (via
vscodevim), Ctrl+h/j/k/l window navigation, SPC leader keybindings, and
Catppuccin Mocha theming.

** Notes on unmatched bindings

These Doom Emacs bindings have no good VS Code equivalent:

| Binding | Emacs does | Can't map because |
|---------+------------+-------------------|
| `SPC n *` | Denote, Howm, Agenda, Org-capture | No PKM or Org-mode system in VS Code |
| `SPC m D` | org-download clipboard/screenshot | No org-download equivalent |
| `SPC w e` | evil-window-exchange | VS Code can't swap editor group positions |
| `C-c c c` | Claude Code transient | No Claude Code for VS Code |
| `C-.` | embark-act | No minibuffer action system |
| `s` / `S` | Journal log/task insert | Org-mode only, no VS Code equivalent |
| `C-= / C-- / C-+ / C-_` | Window resize | VS Code has no window resize commands |

* Prerequisites — Extensions to Install

Required for this config to work:

| Extension | ID | Purpose | Required |
|-----------+----+---------+----------|
| Vim | =vscodevim.vim= | Vim modal editing (Evil equivalent) | Yes |
| GitLens | =eamodio.gitlens= | Inline Git blame, history (Magit-like) | No |
| Error Lens | =usernamehw.errorlens= | Inline diagnostics (Flymake equivalent) | No |

Install from the Extensions panel (Ctrl+Shift+X) or run:

#+begin_src powershell
code --install-extension vscodevim.vim
code --install-extension eamodio.gitlens
code --install-extension usernamehw.errorlens
#+end_src

Catppuccin Mocha with pink accents across the entire UI.

** Editor Behavior

Font ligatures, relative line numbers for Vim navigation, format on save,
smooth cursor animations, and indentation guides.

#+begin_src json
  "editor.fontSize": 14,
  "editor.fontFamily": "JetBrainsMono NFM, Fira Code, monospace",
  "editor.fontLigatures": true,
  "editor.lineNumbers": "relative",
  "editor.minimap.enabled": false,
  "editor.formatOnSave": true,
  "editor.cursorSmoothCaretAnimation": "on",
  "editor.cursorBlinking": "smooth",
  "editor.tabSize": 2,
  "editor.insertSpaces": true,
  "editor.detectIndentation": true,
  "editor.smoothScrolling": true,
  "editor.scrollBeyondLastLine": false,
  "editor.renderWhitespace": "selection",
  "editor.bracketPairColorization.enabled": true,
  "editor.guides.bracketPairs": true,
  "editor.guides.indentation": true,
  "editor.renderLineHighlight": "all",
  "editor.mouseWheelScrollSensitivity": 3,
  "editor.multiCursorModifier": "alt",
  "editor.copyWithSyntaxHighlighting": false,
  "editor.suggestSelection": "first",
  "editor.snippetSuggestions": "top",
  "editor.quickSuggestions": {
    "other": true,
    "comments": false,
    "strings": false
  },
  "editor.parameterHints.enabled": true,
#+end_src

** Vim Configuration

Full Doom Emacs Evil parity: SPC leader, H/L for tabs, g+/g-/g0 for text
scale, Ctrl+h/j/k/l for window nav, Ctrl+e for explorer, Q remapped,
Ex mode disabled, jj → Esc.

#+begin_src json
  "vim.useCtrlKeys": true,
  "vim.leader": "<space>",
  "vim.easymotion": true,
  "vim.surround": true,
  "vim.hlsearch": true,
  "vim.highlightedyank.enable": true,
  "vim.highlightedyank.color": "#5e3a59",
  "vim.foldfix": true,
  "vim.disableEx": true,

  "vim.normalModeKeyBindingsNonRecursive": [
    { "before": ["<C-h>"], "commands": ["workbench.action.focusLeftGroup"] },
    { "before": ["<C-j>"], "commands": ["workbench.action.focusBelowGroup"] },
    { "before": ["<C-k>"], "commands": ["workbench.action.focusAboveGroup"] },
    { "before": ["<C-l>"], "commands": ["workbench.action.focusRightGroup"] },
    { "before": ["g", "+"], "commands": ["editor.action.fontZoomIn"] },
    { "before": ["g", "-"], "commands": ["editor.action.fontZoomOut"] },
    { "before": ["g", "0"], "commands": ["editor.action.fontZoomReset"] },
    { "before": ["H"], "commands": ["workbench.action.previousEditor"] },
    { "before": ["L"], "commands": ["workbench.action.nextEditor"] },
    { "before": ["Q"], "commands": ["workbench.action.showCommands"] },

    { "before": ["<C-e>"], "commands": ["workbench.action.toggleSidebarVisibility"] },
    { "before": ["<leader>", "e"], "commands": ["workbench.action.toggleSidebarVisibility"] },

    { "before": ["<leader>", "f", "f"], "commands": ["workbench.action.quickOpen"] },
    { "before": ["<leader>", "f", "r"], "commands": ["workbench.action.openRecent"] },
    { "before": ["<leader>", "f", "s"], "commands": ["workbench.action.files.save"] },

    { "before": ["<leader>", "b", "x"], "commands": ["workbench.action.closeActiveEditor"] },
    { "before": ["<leader>", "b", "b"], "commands": ["workbench.action.quickOpenPreviousRecentlyUsedEditor"] },
    { "before": ["<leader>", "b", "s"], "commands": ["workbench.action.files.newUntitledFile"] },
    { "before": ["<leader>", ","], "commands": ["workbench.action.quickOpenPreviousRecentlyUsedEditor"] },

    { "before": ["<leader>", "/"], "commands": ["workbench.action.findInFiles"] },
    { "before": ["<leader>", "s", "p"], "commands": ["workbench.action.findInFiles"] },

    { "before": ["<leader>", "t", "n"], "commands": ["workbench.action.newEditorTab"] },
    { "before": ["<leader>", "t", "x"], "commands": ["workbench.action.closeActiveEditor"] },
    { "before": ["<leader>", "t", "d"], "commands": ["workbench.action.splitEditorDuplicate"] },
    { "before": ["<leader>", "t", "o"], "commands": ["workbench.action.closeOtherEditors"] },
    { "before": ["<leader>", "t", ","], "commands": ["workbench.action.moveEditorLeftInGroup"] },
    { "before": ["<leader>", "t", "."], "commands": ["workbench.action.moveEditorRightInGroup"] },

    { "before": ["<leader>", "w", "v"], "commands": ["workbench.action.splitEditorRight"] },
    { "before": ["<leader>", "w", "s"], "commands": ["workbench.action.splitEditorDown"] },
    { "before": ["<leader>", "w", "x"], "commands": ["workbench.action.closeEditorsAndGroup"] },
    { "before": ["<leader>", "w", "o"], "commands": ["workbench.action.closeEditorsInOtherGroups"] },

    { "before": ["<leader>", "."], "commands": ["workbench.action.quickOpen"] },
    { "before": ["<leader>", "p", "f"], "commands": ["workbench.action.quickOpen"] },

    { "before": ["<leader>", "s", "d"], "commands": ["workbench.action.findInFiles"] },

    { "before": ["<leader>", "b", "S"], "commands": ["workbench.action.files.newUntitledFile"] },

    { "before": ["<leader>", "T", "w"], "commands": ["editor.action.toggleWordWrap"] },
    { "before": ["<leader>", "T", "u"], "commands": ["workbench.action.toggleFullScreen"] }
  ],
  "vim.insertModeKeyBindings": [
    { "before": ["j", "j"], "after": ["<Esc>"] }
  ],
#+end_src

** Terminal Settings

Matches Emacs vterm: Nerd Font, smooth cursor, inline in editor group.

#+begin_src json
  "terminal.integrated.fontFamily": "CaskaydiaCove Nerd Font Mono, CaskaydiaMono NFM, monospace",
  "terminal.integrated.fontSize": 14,
  "terminal.integrated.defaultLocation": "editor",
  "terminal.integrated.cursorBlinking": true,
  "terminal.integrated.cursorStyle": "line",
  "terminal.integrated.smoothScrolling": true,
#+end_src

** Explorer Settings

Treemacs-like behavior: consistent indentation, visible guides, no
confirmation prompts.

#+begin_src json
  "explorer.confirmDelete": false,
  "explorer.confirmDragAndDrop": false,
  "workbench.sideBar.location": "left",
  "workbench.tree.indent": 20,
  "workbench.tree.renderIndentGuides": "always",
#+end_src

** Git Settings

Smart commits, auto-fetch, no sync confirmation — matches Magit convenience.

#+begin_src json
  "git.enableSmartCommit": true,
  "git.autofetch": true,
  "git.confirmSync": false,
#+end_src

** Search Settings

Exclude noise, respect .gitignore, follow symlinks only when needed.

#+begin_src json
  "search.exclude": {
    "**/node_modules": true,
    "**/bower_components": true,
    "**/dist": true,
    "**/build": true,
    ".git": true
  },
  "search.useIgnoreFiles": true,
  "search.followSymlinks": false,
#+end_src

** File Settings

Auto-save on focus loss, trim whitespace, final newlines — matches Emacs
whitespace config.

#+begin_src json
  "files.autoSave": "onFocusChange",
  "files.trimTrailingWhitespace": true,
  "files.insertFinalNewline": true,
  "files.trimFinalNewlines": true,
  "files.exclude": {
    "**/.git": true,
    "**/.DS_Store": true,
    "**/Thumbs.db": true
  },
#+end_src

** Diff Editor

Show side-by-side by default, preserve trimming fidelity.

#+begin_src json
  "diffEditor.ignoreTrimWhitespace": false,
  "diffEditor.renderSideBySide": true,
#+end_src

** Workbench / Window

No startup page, compact editor labels, visible activity bar and status bar.

#+begin_src json
  "window.titleBarStyle": "native",
  "workbench.startupEditor": "none",
  "workbench.editor.labelFormat": "short",
  "workbench.editor.tabSizing": "shrink",
  "workbench.editor.scrollToSwitchTabs": true,
  "workbench.editor.closeOnFileDelete": true,
  "workbench.activityBar.visible": true,
  "workbench.statusBar.visible": true,
  "workbench.list.smoothScrolling": true,
#+end_src

** Copilot Configuration

Always-on completions for all file types. Custom instruction for
Basic Memory integration.

#+begin_src json
  "github.copilot.chat.codeGeneration.instructions": [
    {
      "text": "Before answering, call `search_notes` for relevant context. After learning durable new facts about my setup, preferences, or decisions, call `write_note` so other agents benefit."
    }
  ],
  "github.copilot.enable": {
    "*": true,
    "plaintext": false,
    "markdown": true,
    "yaml": false
  },
#+end_src

Enable automatic schema downloads for reliable IntelliSense.

  },

}
#+end_src

* Keybindings

Window navigation (Ctrl+h/j/k/l) is handled by vscodevim in normal mode via
settings above. These keybindings cover non-vim contexts.

#+begin_src json :tangle keybindings.json
// =============================================================
// DO NOT EDIT THIS FILE DIRECTLY.
// Generated from ~/.config/vscode/vscode.org
// Edit that file, tangle with `tangle vscode`,
// then restart VS Code for changes to take effect.
// =============================================================

[
  // Window navigation — non-editor contexts (editor handled by vscodevim)
  // !terminalFocus prevents conflicts with shell Ctrl keys
  { "key": "ctrl+h", "command": "workbench.action.focusLeftGroup", "when": "!terminalFocus" },
  { "key": "ctrl+j", "command": "workbench.action.focusBelowGroup", "when": "!terminalFocus" },
  { "key": "ctrl+k", "command": "workbench.action.focusAboveGroup", "when": "!terminalFocus" },
  { "key": "ctrl+l", "command": "workbench.action.focusRightGroup", "when": "!terminalFocus" },

  // Open integrated terminal — like C-c C-c vterm
  // No when clause needed — Ctrl+` is VS Code's terminal chord
  { "key": "ctrl+`", "command": "workbench.action.terminal.toggleTerminal" },

  // Toggle explorer sidebar — like SPC e in Doom
  // !terminalFocus: terminal uses Ctrl+e for End of Line.
  // Ctrl+b (built-in) also toggles sidebar, use that from terminal.
  { "key": "ctrl+e", "command": "workbench.action.toggleSidebarVisibility", "when": "!terminalFocus" },

  // Ctrl+b is already the default VS Code toggleSidebarVisibility
  // Ctrl+b from terminal toggles sidebar instead of backward-char
]
#+end_src
